component.name: Consilium
component.summary: Route AI chats across local and optional providers

description.p: Consilium is a free and open-source desktop harness for chatting with local models, official provider command-line tools, and optional direct APIs.
Choose a provider manually or use an explainable routing profile. Conversations stay in a recoverable local session store, and the application has no first-party telemetry or paid feature gates.
Initial Consilium desktop release with local and optional provider routes, explainable routing, streaming responses, and recoverable session history.
